title: ngi ai nguh ia me kotrai
lyrics:
ngi ai nguh ia me kotrai
jing ieid jing sbun me ai
ia ngi ka jing koit jing khiah
ba ngin don lang kumne
kum shipara
tylli kawei ngin long
kum ki shipai u krist
da jing shitrhem ngin trei
bad ia ieid markylliang
haba don ki jing eh jing tynjuh
ngin ai mynsiem i wei ia iwei
ngin ym kynran dien ngin tur
shaphrang daka jing ngeit
ryngkat ka jing dwai lang
